data_policy: External opponents only; INFO_NONE. No external engine source, network weights, analysis labels, opening books or tablebases used.
not_adopted: compact piece storage: median measured fixed-search speed ratio about 1.00
whole-position hash memoization: median measured ratio about 0.95
promotion: Requires held-out evidence; no promotion from the exploratory screen alone.
rejected_candidates: static-evaluation cache: 31/64 screen despite noisy timing gain
compact piece storage: no timing gain
whole-position hash memoization: no timing gain
target-based king-ring pressure: 0.96 median speed ratio; exact evaluations preserved but no gain
overlay-based legality test: 1.01 median timing ratio, no demonstrated useful gain

validation_design.promotion_gate: Both fresh 128-game batteries complete; combined pair-aware 95% point-score interval above 0.5; no recorded candidate technical failures; opponent failures reported separately; rules/protocol/sanitizer and bounded-mate checks pass; actual 3+2 and 10+5 games complete. Separate conditional decisive-pair SPRT reported as additional evidence.
validation_design.limitation: Approximate statistical evidence for sampled starts and requested short limits, not Elo, move accuracy or tournament guarantee.
